description: This file defines the TalkOverlayController class in Swift, managing the presentation, dismissal, and state updates of a user interface overlay for a talk feature. It also includes a custom NSHostingView subclass for handling user interactions.

classes.name: TalkOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton controller managing the talk overlay UI, including presenting, dismissing, and updating overlay states.

classes.name: TalkOverlayHostingView
classes.description: A custom NSHostingView class that overrides acceptance of first mouse events to always accept them.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Presents the overlay window and sets up its view hierarchy.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay window with an animation.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current phase of the talk overlay and logs the change.

methods.name: updatePaused
methods.description: Updates the paused state of the overlay and logs the change.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the level of the overlay, constrained between 0 and 1.

methods.name: currentWindowOrigin
methods.description: Returns the origin point of the overlay window.

methods.name: setWindowOrigin
methods.description: Sets the origin point of the overlay window.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures the overlay window if it does not already exist.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the rectangle frame for the overlay window based on screen bounds.
